summary: An English market-town chandlery. Facing the street is a red-brick shop storey with a projecting candle-filled bay window and a separate family door. Above it is a jettied dark-oak and calcite half-timbered storey under a 45° slate gable with two dormers and an east-gable chimney. Behind it are a brick workshop with its own tall rendering-hearth chimney, an open drying lean-to for the candle racks, and a beehive garden that supplies the wax, so the street front reads as a shop, house and workshop all at once.
concept_subject: A candle maker's home and shop in an English market town, its eaves to a cobbled street (the street is to the north). The main house is 13 blocks wide on a grey stone-brick plinth. Its ground storey is warm red brick with long-and-short stone quoins. In the middle a five-wide shop bay window stands one block out: dark-oak posts, three panes glowing with clusters of yellow and white candles, and a dark-oak fascia board carrying a sign. A dark-oak shop door with a glazed transom stands to its left and a separate family door with a little stone hood to its right. Over this the upper storey juts out one block on upside-down dark-oak brackets. It is half-timbered: near-black dark-oak posts and beams over off-white calcite daub, a pair of windows above the bay, and diagonal braces in the outer panels. It sits under a 45° grey slate roof with dark-oak verges, a slab ridge and two small gabled dormers facing the street. A red-brick chimney stack with a dark band and a smoking cap climbs the east gable end. A dark-oak bracket at the west corner holds a hanging sign with a lit three-candle cluster on its tip. Behind the house runs a lower, single-storey brick workshop under its own slate gable, with a second tall brick chimney at its back gable sending up a tall plume of smoke from the tallow-rendering hearth. Against its east side is an open dark-oak lean-to sheltering racks of drying candles and tallow barrels. A spruce picket fence closes a back garden with a row of four beehives and a bright flower bed, a woodpile by the chimney, barrels and a cauldron by the gate, an apple tree and a dirt path from the side gate.
concept_size: 26 wide, 34 deep (house 13 x 11, workshop 9 x 10 behind), 2 storeys plus a 45° roof, ridge at 16 and chimney to 19 blocks
